subject.title: Feature Request: Support copying accounts / easy management for multiple accounts on the same platform

question: Should CodexBar adopt the generic same-provider instance model described in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1843, and should account duplication be a supported creation path within that model?
rationale: The requested UI action changes provider identity, authentication isolation, and persisted account behavior; those boundaries need an intentional product and data-model contract before implementation.

options.title: Use the canonical generic design
options.body: Treat duplicate/copy as one creation affordance in the generic provider-instance model, with explicit rules for which settings may be copied and which credentials must be re-entered.

options.title: Limit the feature to provider-specific slices
options.body: Approve only providers that can safely use the existing token-account model, leaving generic provider duplication out of scope.

recommendation.title: Use the canonical generic design
recommendation.body: Treat duplicate/copy as one creation affordance in the generic provider-instance model, with explicit rules for which settings may be copied and which credentials must be re-entered.
